present_illness.present_illness: Pain in the left cheek for several days, often dull or distended, and occasionally spontaneous pain. The pain is severe, especially at night. I woke up with pain last night and came to our hospital for treatment today.

oral_examination.oral_examination: 36. White fillings were seen on the maxillary surface, black caries were seen on the edges, deep caries and pulp were found in the distal adjacent maxillary surface, and there was slight pain during probing; cold examination was sensitive; there was no obvious loosening; no percussion pain; and no other obvious abnormalities were found. X-ray films showed low-density images of the coronal part and pulp, and no obvious dark shadow around the apex.

treatment_plan.definitive: 36 root canal treatments. The patient signed the informed consent.
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.
